manufacturing_grouping_structure.rationale: Groups for cross-validation and calibration are defined by planned independent physical manufacturing shifts and lot allocations. Physical batch independence must be empirically verified post-manufacturing.

SHIFT_BLOCK_3.description: Vertex extrema & thermal limits compounding run

manufacturing_independence_verification_.description: Required empirical evidence fields to prove batch independence before physical data ingestion is qualified
disqualification_rules: Batches sharing the same melt vessel charge without intermediate cleaning/reweighing are collapsed to single degrees of freedom
Missing operator signature or unrecorded lot number disqualifies batch from primary 16-run physical N count

split_conformal_calibration_design.rule: Calibration nonconformity quantile q_hat is computed strictly on a dedicated calibration shift partition and never shares observations with model training or evaluation folds.

BLIND_EVALUATION_PARTITION.note: P017 and P018 are supplemental and evaluated independently

split_conformal_calibration_design.disjoint_check: Training, Calibration, and Evaluation primary run sets are mutually exclusive with zero overlap.

brand_requirement_spec_targets.description: Provisional technical verification targets. Final consumer-facing product specifications remain open pending controlled athletic user trials.

Hardness_gf.functional_relevance: Stick mechanical integrity under high temperature and repetitive friction without crumbling

Transfer_Index_g.functional_relevance: Uniform protective barrier film formation without excessive greasy residue or fabric staining

Drop_Point_C.functional_relevance: Thermal endurance against pocket heat, sun exposure, and friction-induced melting

Friction_CoF.functional_relevance: Sustained kinetic friction reduction against skin-on-skin and fabric-on-skin shear

sensitivity_diagnostic_governance.mahalanobis_threshold_rule: DM <= 2.45 represents the maximum distance from design centroid within the 18-run DOE coordinate envelope (chi-square 3-dof 95% critical value = 7.81). This is a descriptive geometric design-support boundary, NOT an empirical claim of physical validation or accuracy.
